# 游戏开发技能

帮助开发HTML5小游戏的专家技能，专注于麻将、扑克、棋牌等类型的浏览器游戏。

## 快速开始

1. 确认游戏类型和核心玩法
2. 选择技术方案（纯前端/局域网联机/服务器版）
3. 开始实现游戏逻辑

## 游戏类型

### 棋牌游戏
- **麻将**：桐城自摸、血战到底、四川麻将等
- **扑克**：掼蛋、斗地主、德州扑克、炸金花等
- **其他**：象棋、围棋、五子棋等

### 技术方案

| 方案 | 适用场景 | 技术栈 |
|------|----------|--------|
| 纯前端 | 单机游戏、本地多人 | HTML + CSS + JS |
| 局域网联机 | 家庭/办公室多人 | WebSocket + Node.js |
| 服务器版 | 互联网多人 | Socket.io + 数据库 |

## 开发流程

### 步骤 1：需求分析
- 确定游戏规则和特殊玩法
- 确定玩家数量和交互方式
- 确定是否需要AI对手

### 步骤 2：界面设计
- 游戏桌面布局
- 卡牌/麻将牌样式
- 玩家位置和交互按钮
- 动画效果

### 步骤 3：核心逻辑
- 游戏状态管理
- 牌型判断算法
- 回合流程控制
- 胜负判定

### 步骤 4：网络功能（如需要）
- WebSocket 通信
- 房间管理
- 玩家状态同步
- 断线重连处理

## 代码规范

### 文件组织
```
game-name/
├── index.html        # 主页面
├── game.js          # 游戏逻辑
├── server.js        # 服务器（如需要）
├── styles.css       # 样式（可内联）
└── README.md        # 使用说明
```

### 命名约定
- 函数：驼峰命名 `calculateScore()`
- 常量：大写下划线 `MAX_PLAYERS`
- CSS类：短横线命名 `.player-hand`

### 样式风格
- 使用渐变背景营造游戏氛围
- 金色/绿色主题适合棋牌游戏
- 按钮要有明显的悬停和点击效果

## 常用算法

            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a472a 0%, #2d5a3d 100%);
            min-height: 100vh;
            color: #fff;
        }

        /* 大厅样式 - 登录界面 */
        #loginScreen {
            position: fixed;
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: rgba(13, 40, 24, 0.98);
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            z-index: 200;
            overflow-y: auto;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        #loginScreen h1 {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #ffd700;
            text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
            animation: glow 2s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
        }

        @keyframes glow {
            from { text-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd700, 0 0 20px #ffd700; }
            to { text-shadow: 0 0 20px #ffd700, 0 0 40px #ffd700, 0 0 60px #ff8c00; }
        }

        #loginScreen .subtitle {
            color: #90ee90;
            font-size: 18px;
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .name-bar {
            display: flex;
            gap: 15px;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            padding: 20px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border-radius: 10px;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .name-bar label {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .name-bar input {
            width: 200px;
            padding: 10px 15px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
            border: 2px solid #ffd700;
            border-radius: 8px;
            color: #fff;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .name-bar input:focus {
            outline: none;
            box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffd700;
        }

        .name-bar input::placeholder {
            color: #666;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表容器 */
        .lobby-container {
            width: 90%;
            max-width: 800px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 20px;
            padding: 0 10px;
        }

        .lobby-header h2 {
            color: #ffd700;
            font-size: 24px;
        }

        .btn {
            padding: 10px 20px;
            font-size: 16px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 5px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: #4CAF50;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            background: #45a049;
        }

        .btn-danger {
            background: #f44336;
            color: white;
        }

        .btn-secondary {
            background: #607D8B;
            color: white;
        }

        .table-list {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(200px, 1fr));
            gap: 15px;
            padding: 20px;
        }

        .table-card {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
            border-radius: 10px;
            padding: 15px;
            text-align: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            border: 2px solid transparent;
        }

        .table-card:hover {
            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .table-card.empty {
            border-color: #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-card.waiting {
            border-color: #FFC107;
        }

        .table-card.playing {
            border-color: #2196F3;
        }

        .table-card.full {
            border-color: #f44336;
            opacity: 0.7;
        }

        .table-card.new-table {
            background: rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3);
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
        }

        .table-number {
            font-size: 1.5em;
            font-weight: bold;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .table-status {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        .table-players {
            margin-top: 10px;
            font-size: 0.8em;
        }

        /* 牌桌列表中的小型圆桌布局 */
        .mini-table-layout {
            position: relative;
            width: 120px;
            height: 120px;
            margin: 10px auto;
        }

        .mini-table-center {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a3d2a 100%);
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .mini-seat {
            position: absolute;
            text-align: center;
            width: 32px;
        }

        /* 逆时针顺序: 1(底) → 2(右) → 3(顶) → 4(左) */
        .mini-seat-1 { bottom: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-2 { right: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-3 { top: 0; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); }
        .mini-seat-4 { left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); }

        .mini-seat-avatar {
            width: 32px;
            height: 32px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            border: 2px solid #555;
            transition: all 0.3s;
            color: #fff;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar.occupied {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #4CAF50, #2E7D32);
            border-color: #81C784;
        }

        .mini-seat-avatar:hover:not(.occupied) {
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.3);
            border-color: #FFD700;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        .table-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            padding: 0 5px;
        }

        .table-id {
            color: #FFD700;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .table-mode-badge {
            font-size: 11px;
            padding: 2px 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.2);
            color: #FFD700;
        }

        .table-footer {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #ccc;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .table-footer.full {
            color: #ff6b6b;
        }

        .table-footer.playing {
            color: #4dabf7;
        }

        .deck-info {
            text-align: center;
            font-size: 11px;
            color: #90ee90;
            margin-top: 5px;
            padding: 3px 8px;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3);
            border-radius: 4px;
        }

        /* 创建新桌卡片样式 */
        .create-table-card {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.3), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.3));
            border: 2px dashed #4CAF50;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            min-height: 200px;
        }

        .create-table-card .plus {
            font-size: 48px;
            color: #4CAF50;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        .create-table-card .text {
            color: #4CAF50;
            font-size: 16px;
            margin-top: 10px;
        }

        .create-table-card:hover {
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.5), rgba(46, 125, 50, 0.5));
        }

        /* 游戏界面样式 */
        .game-container {
            display: none;
            width: 100vw;
            height: 100vh;
            position: relative;
        }

        .game-table {
            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            position: relative;
            background: radial-gradient(ellipse at center, #2d5a3d 0%, #1a472a 100%);
        }

        /* 玩家区域 */
        .player-area {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
        }

        .player-area.bottom {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 80%;
        }

        .player-area.top {
            top: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.left {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-area.right {
            right: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
        }

        .player-info {
            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
            padding: 8px 15px;
            border-radius: 5px;
            margin-bottom: 5px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .player-info.active {
            border: 2px solid #FFD700;
            box-shadow: 0 0 10px #FFD700;
        }

        .player-name {
            font-weight: bold;
        }

        .hand-count {
            font-size: 0.9em;
            color: #ccc;
        }

        /* 展示区 */
        .showed-area {
            display: flex;
            gap: 5px;
            margin: 5px 0;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
        }

        .showed-card {
            width: 30px;
            height: 40px;
            background: #fff;
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            color: #333;
        }

        .showed-card.fa {
            background: #FFD700;
        }

        .showed-card.gang {
            background: #90EE90;
        }

        /* 手牌区域 */
        .hand-area {
            display: flex;
            flex-wrap: wrap;
            justify-content: center;
            gap: 1px;
            padding: 10px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a472a 0%, #0d2818 100%);
            border-radius: 10px;
            max-width: 100%;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 麻将牌精灵图样式 */
        .tile-sprite {
            /* 精灵图参数：图片617x373，4行9列 */
            /* 每张牌在精灵图中的完整尺寸（含白色外框） */
            --sprite-tile-width: 68.5px;   /* 617/9 = 每张牌宽度 */
            --sprite-tile-height: 93.25px; /* 373/4 = 每张牌高度 */
            --scale: 0.65;
            /* 显示尺寸等于精灵图中每张牌的完整尺寸（含边框） */
            width: calc(var(--sprite-tile-width) * var(--scale));
            height: calc(var(--sprite-tile-height) * var(--scale));
            background-image: url('麻将大图.jpg');
            background-size: calc(617px * var(--scale)) calc(373px * var(--scale));
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 2px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 3px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 4px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 5px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 1px solid #d8d0c8;
            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .tile-sprite:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 3px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 5px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 7px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 9px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
            z-index: 10;
        }

        .tile-sprite.selected {
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 4px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 7px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 10px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 13px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            z-index: 20;
        }

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .tile-sprite.wild {
            border: 2px solid #ffa000;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #ff8f00,
                0 2px 0 #f57c00,
                0 3px 0 #ef6c00,
                0 4px 0 #e65100,
                0 5px 3px rgba(255,152,0,0.4),
                0 0 10px rgba(255,160,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .tile-sprite.wild::before {
            content: '癞';
            position: absolute;
            top: -2px;
            right: -2px;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5722 0%, #e64a19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* 筒子位置 (第1行: row 0) */
        .tile-sprite.tong1 { background-position: calc(-0 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong2 { background-position: calc(-1 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong3 { background-position: calc(-2 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong4 { background-position: calc(-3 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong5 { background-position: calc(-4 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong6 { background-position: calc(-5 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong7 { background-position: calc(-6 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong8 { background-position: calc(-7 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong9 { background-position: calc(-8 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-0 * 93.25px * 0.65); }

        /* 条子位置 (第2行: row 1) */
        .tile-sprite.tiao1 { background-position: calc(-0 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao2 { background-position: calc(-1 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao3 { background-position: calc(-2 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao4 { background-position: calc(-3 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao5 { background-position: calc(-4 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao6 { background-position: calc(-5 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao7 { background-position: calc(-6 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao8 { background-position: calc(-7 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao9 { background-position: calc(-8 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-1 * 93.25px * 0.65); }

        /* 万子位置 (第3行: row 2) */
        .tile-sprite.wan1 { background-position: calc(-0 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan2 { background-position: calc(-1 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan3 { background-position: calc(-2 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan4 { background-position: calc(-3 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan5 { background-position: calc(-4 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan6 { background-position: calc(-5 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan7 { background-position: calc(-6 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan8 { background-position: calc(-7 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan9 { background-position: calc(-8 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-2 * 93.25px * 0.65); }

        /* 风牌位置 (第4行: row 3) */
        .tile-sprite.feng_dong { background-position: calc(-0 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_nan { background-position: calc(-1 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_xi { background-position: calc(-2 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_bei { background-position: calc(-3 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }

        /* 箭牌位置 (第4行: row 3, 续) */
        .tile-sprite.jian_zhong { background-position: calc(-4 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.jian_fa { background-position: calc(-5 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.jian_bai { background-position: calc(-6 * 68.5px * 0.65) calc(-3 * 93.25px * 0.65); }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 图片中的真实样式 */
        .card {
            width: 34px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #e8e8e0 50%, #ddd8d0 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 2px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 3px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 4px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 5px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 1px solid #d8d0c8;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 3px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 5px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 7px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 9px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
            z-index: 10;

                0 4px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 7px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 10px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 13px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);

        /* 牌面内容容器 */

            width: 28px;

            flex-direction: column;

            background: #fafaf5;

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;
        }

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 24px;
            height: 32px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #90caf9, #1976d2 70%, #0d47a1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆带花边 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #64b5f6, #1976d2 60%, #0d47a1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; justify-self: center; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;

        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
                // 连接后立即获取牌桌列表
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    showGame();  // 确保显示游戏界面
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录

            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;

            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');

            draggedCardId = null;

            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (!target || !draggedCardId) return;

            const targetCardId = target.dataset.cardId;
            if (targetCardId === draggedCardId) return;

            // 重新排序手牌
            const fromIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === draggedCardId);
            const toIndex = gameState.myHand.findIndex(c => c.id === targetCardId);

            if (fromIndex !== -1 && toIndex !== -1) {
                const [movedCard] = gameState.myHand.splice(fromIndex, 1);
                gameState.myHand.splice(toIndex, 0, movedCard);
                renderMyHand();
            }

            target.classList.remove('drag-over');
        }
